headline: TLDN Strengthens Business Foundation Through Productivity and Asset Optimization
summary: TLDN focused on productivity and technology to grow its plantation business and reported net profit of Rp875.25 billion through September 2026.
why: TLDN is an Indonesian plantation company, and its earnings are tied to palm oil and other agricultural commodity prices and output.
original_headline: TLDN Perkuat Fondasi Bisnis lewat Produktivitas dan Optimalisasi Aset
